text:
matt: Vendor emailed updated plan — partial replacements only. 10 units flagged in EU pool; 6 can ship by air in 72h, 4 via sea ETA ~12 days. Serial list has 10 mismatches.

olivia: Paste AWB + mismatches here? Is vendor covering expedite cost?

matt: Copy from vendor email:
```
AWB: 7812-PL-5591, 7812-PL-5592
Serial mismatch: S/Ns [EUX-1001..EUX-1010] vs expected EUX-0001..EUX-0010
Plan: 6 air (72h), 4 sea (12d)
```

ana: Sea leg needs rebooking before EOD tomorrow or it gets pushed to next vessel. Also need importer of record for sea.

kai: Ops note — alpha EU pool is at 85% reserved. If we don't get >=6 units by Tue morning, we'll hit throttle thresholds. Can we short-borrow US spare pool for 48-72h?

olivia: Vendor offered 50% expedite fee waiver if we accept split shipments. Procurement prefers consolidated but can accept split to meet SLOs pending finance ok.

matt: procurement-bot sent invoice preview: expedite air + brokerage $12,400; sea rebook $1,200; waiver reduces extra to $6,800. Suggest ops take 25% co-share.

procurement-bot: Invoice preview attached. Approval required from finance for remaining balance. /approve-cost ops 4000 ?

kai: Ops can commit up to $4k from emergency reserve. Ana — can depot EU3 handle QC on sea arrivals (48-72h)?

ana: Yes — EU3 handles importer paperwork and depot QC, but sea units will be placed on hold until QC complete.

matt: Decision: approve split routing. Vendor to send 6 air -> EU hub (mark 'priority'), 4 sea -> EU3 depot with hold-for-QC. Ops to borrow 2 US spares to cover immediate pressure. Olivia to finalize cost-share with finance and confirm AWBs.

olivia: I'll loop in finance and confirm with vendor now. Will post updated AWB and manifest here when vendor replies. :thumbsup:

matt: Note: log RMA IDs in ticket #4589, keep serials segregated, label sea units 'hold for depot QC'. Updating vendor now.
